packageRules.description: Automerge patch, minor and digest updates once CI is green. Nothing here reaches a user until it is vendored into a consumer and passes that consumer's release path, so a green run is a stronger signal here than in a consumer.

setup-python installs from actions/python-versions' manifest, which lands over an hour after the CPython release Renovate reads. A bump raised in that gap fails every Python job at setup, so hold it until the manifest is certain to list it.
The gitleaks download is checked against GITLEAKS_SHA256 beside it, which Renovate cannot compute, so the bump PR fails the Secrets job until a person updates the checksum. Never automerge it.
prBodyNotes: Set `GITLEAKS_SHA256` in `.forgejo/workflows/ci.yml` to the checksum of `gitleaks_<version>_linux_x64.tar.gz` from the release's checksums file before merging; the Secrets job fails until then.

customManagers.description: Pinned container images inside the shared scripts. They are bumped here and nowhere else: a consumer that bumped its vendored copy would fail its own drift check, so the bump reaches consumers as a re-vendor.
Version pins annotated with a `# renovate:` comment in the workflows. The annotation is the anchor; the same shape as the consumers', so a pattern learned in one repo reads the same in all.
